tasks.short: Review sketches against the design concept.

steps.what: Extract the title block from the rough sketches.

loop.check: each field is copied from the sheet
loop.stop: stop when a field is not on the sheet
loop.why_not_simpler: title blocks are drawn, not typed, so a fixed position misses them

steps.what: Review sketches and drawings against the design concepts.
Record whether the specifications still match.

tasks.design: Title, revision, and scale are copied from the sheet into {DOCS} only when they are on the sheet. The drafter reviews the rough sketches, drawings, and other engineering data against the design concepts. A copied title block is not a review. Specifications that are not on the sheet are not marked as matching.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reviews started by hunting the revision in the title block, and the concept check was rushed.
tasks.enabler_now: A title block that is actually on the sheet can be copied before the review.
tasks.still_hard: A concept the title block does not carry, and a specification that contradicts the sketch.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see a correct title on a drawing that has left the concept.
tasks.altitude: The title block can be copied. The review of the design concept stays with the drafter.

reach.task: Hold the design concept the sketch is reviewed against.
reach.learn: The title can be copied. The concept review cannot.

evidence.claim: A title block can be copied from a sheet when the fields are on it. That copy is not a design review.
Conformity to the design concept is the drafter's review. A missing field stops the copy rather than being guessed.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Sheet id, produced by the sketch file. A field that is not on the sheet is left blank. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the sketch file the practice already keeps.
unknowns: Which engineering data must be in the review.
research_questions: Are title blocks in a consistent place?
What share of reviews fail on the concept rather than the title?

already_counted.description: The drafter still reviews the sketches.
The drafter still records the match.

incremental.description: The drafter fills a title field the copy could not read.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is copying a title block that is on the sheet. It disappears when the block is nonstandard and the drafter reads it. The concept review remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Draw maps and profiles from surveys.

steps.what: Open the cross-sections and the surveys.
Draw maps, diagrams, and profiles from the surveys.
Check elevations and contours against the survey.

tasks.design: Cross-sections and surveys are opened from {DOCS} as one pack. The drafter draws the maps, diagrams, and profiles, including elevations, topographical contours, and subsurface formations, on the drawing model in {OTHER}. The pack does not draw the map. A survey point is not a tax or permit decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Surveys arrived as files the drafter renamed by hand before drawing.
tasks.enabler_now: The survey pack can be opened. The map is still drawn.
tasks.still_hard: A contour the points do not support, and a subsurface the survey does not show.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see points that are complete and a profile that misreads them.
tasks.altitude: The survey pack is together. The maps and profiles are still drawn by the drafter. No permit is decided.

reach.task: Supply the survey the map is drawn from.
reach.learn: The pack can be opened. The map is still drawn here.

evidence.claim: A survey pack can be opened. It cannot draw a map or a profile.
A map or a symbol reading does not decide a permit or a tax. EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with a legal effect.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Survey id and section id, produced by the survey file. A map with no survey id is not marked drawn. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the survey file the practice already keeps.
unknowns: Which coordinate system the survey uses.
research_questions: Are surveys filed against the sheet?
Which profiles always need the engineer?

already_counted.description: The drafter still draws the maps.
The drafter still checks the contours.

incremental.description: The drafter fetches a section the pack missed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is opening the survey pack. It disappears when the survey is not filed and the drafter hunts it. The drawing time is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Choose the order of work and the view.

steps.what: List the sheets and the scales already specified.
Determine the order of work and the orthographic or isometric presentation.
Record the presentation method the drafter chose.

tasks.design: Sheets and scales already specified are listed from {PROJECT}. The drafter determines the order of work and the method of presentation, including an orthographic or isometric drawing. The list does not choose the view. A sheet with no scale is left for the drafter to set.
tasks.previous_blocker: The order of sheets was a habit, and a job that needed an isometric view got a plan instead.
tasks.enabler_now: Specified scales can be listed. The method is still chosen.
tasks.still_hard: A view the scale list does not suggest, and a sequence the site will not follow.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can tell a specified scale from the view the builder needs.
tasks.altitude: Known scales are listed. The order of work and the presentation stay with the drafter.

reach.task: Expect a presentation method that matches the concept.
reach.learn: The scales can be listed. The method is still chosen here.

evidence.claim: A sheet list can show scales already specified. It cannot choose orthographic or isometric presentation.
The order of work is the drafter's decision. A missing scale is not filled by the list.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Sheet id and scale, produced by the project index. A sheet with no scale is not assigned a view. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the project index the practice already keeps.
research_questions: Are scales stored on the sheet record?
How often is the first method changed?

already_counted.description: The drafter still chooses the method.

incremental.description: The drafter sets a scale the list did not have.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the list of specified scales. It disappears when scales are not stored and the drafter reads the sheets. The choice of presentation remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List the medium and the reproduction specification.
Finish and duplicate the drawings by blueprinting or photography.
Check the copies against the required mediums.

tasks.design: The required medium and the copy count are listed from {DOCS} when the issue instruction names them. The drafter finishes the drawings and duplicates the documentation packages on the blueprinting, photography, or other duplicating equipment. The list does not run the machine. A medium the instruction does not name is not produced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Copy counts were shouted across the print room, and the wrong medium was run.
tasks.enabler_now: A written medium and count can be open. Operating the equipment is unchanged.
tasks.still_hard: A machine jam, a faint line, and a specification that arrives after the run.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter can see a copy that matches the count and is still unreadable.
tasks.altitude: The copy specification can be listed. Finishing and duplicating stay with the drafter on the equipment.

reach.task: Issue a set and expect the copies to be made on the stated medium.
reach.learn: The specification can be listed. The equipment is still operated here.

evidence.claim: A copy specification can list a medium and a count. It cannot finish or duplicate a drawing.
Operating blueprinting or other duplicating equipment is the drafter's work. The equipment's own run is not removed from the person's job by listing the specification.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural or civil drafter in a European practice. National building rules apply. A list does not issue a drawing.
Fields: Medium and copy count, produced by the issue instruction. An instruction with no medium stops the list. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the drafter finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the issue instruction the practice already writes. No extra tool replaces the equipment.
unknowns: Which mediums this office can still produce.
research_questions: Are mediums written down before the run?
What share of copies are rejected as unreadable?

already_counted.description: The drafter still finishes and duplicates.
The drafter still checks the copies.

incremental.description: The drafter confirms a medium the instruction left blank.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the written medium and count. It disappears when the instruction is blank and the drafter asks. Operating the duplicating equipment stays, so the net stays under the machines prior.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reviewing a sketch and drawing a map stay with the drafter. A copy specification can be listed. The person still finishes and duplicates the sheets on the equipment.
reach: Architects review a sketch against the concept, and this job learns a title block is not that review.
Surveying and mapping technicians supply a survey, and this job learns the map is still drawn.
skills_to_grow: Separate a title-block check from a review of the design concept.
Duplicate a sheet only to the medium the specification names.
role.ambitious_version: A sketch review starts from the current sheets, and blueprinting still runs on the equipment the drafter operates.
